Open the [comfort-settings prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=settings). Set **50 bookmarks**, **Large** text, and **Name A–Z**, then select **Save settings**. Confirm that the library returns alphabetized with larger card text and reports 50 bookmarks per page.

I’ve assumed these are personal defaults that persist for future visits, while the regular ordering menu can still temporarily change the current list without replacing the saved default.
